Passive visual fixation (F) operates as a deterministic kernel K(F,B) → E, where E is eye closure. Kinetic suggestion field (K) applies tactile modulation to neural regions, producing T = g(K,R). Failure modes arise when operator-subject mismatch occurs (O ≠ S) or when sensory thresholds are not met (B < threshold, K < threshold). The system exhibits nonlinearity in state transitions due to feedback loops between operator intent and subject physiology.
